display.name: Sentry
display.blurb: Triage errors during a run — list projects, query issues and events, resolve/assign issues, and inspect releases, teams, and cron monitors. Authenticated with a brokered org auth token (injected at the egress proxy, never seen by the agent).

token.hint: Create a user auth token under Sentry Settings → Account → API → User Auth Tokens.

cli.doc:
Use `sentry` to triage Sentry from this session — list projects, query issues/events, resolve or assign issues, and inspect releases, teams, and cron monitors. Authentication is automatic: the egress proxy injects the org auth token (Bearer) on requests to sentry.io; `SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN` is a managed placeholder. Do NOT run any login or set a real token. Calls to a path your profile didn't grant are denied at the network boundary, not authenticated.

Most commands take an <org> slug (and some a <project> slug). Find them first with `sentry orgs`.

Commands and the power each needs:
  sentry orgs                                List your organizations (organizations:read)
  sentry projects <org>                      List an org's projects (projects:read)
  sentry issues <org> [query=...] [project=...]   List an org's issues (issues:read)
  sentry issue <org> <issue-id>              Retrieve one issue (issues:read)
  sentry resolve <org> <issue-id>            Resolve an issue (issues:write)
  sentry ignore <org> <issue-id>             Ignore/mute an issue (issues:write)
  sentry events <org> [field=value ...]      Query org events (events:read)
  sentry releases <org>                      List releases (releases:read)
  sentry teams <org>                         List teams (teams:read)
  sentry monitors <org>                      List cron monitors (monitors:read)
  sentry get <path> [field=value ...]        Raw GET under https://sentry.io (path may be /api/0/... or an /api/0-relative tail)
  sentry api <METHOD> <path> [-- curl-args]  Raw call with an explicit method

Responses are JSON; issue queries support Sentry search syntax (e.g. `query=is:unresolved`). Paths starting without /api are auto-prefixed with /api/0/.
